context_for_next_testing_agent: All mega menu navigation features tested and working: 1) Desktop mega menu opens on hover with 180ms close delay, closes on ESC key, 4 columns with sub-links, CTA at bottom. 2) Active states work correctly - Leistungen highlighted when on any /mobilitaet/*, /architektur-raum/*, /markenkommunikation/*, /design-konzepte paths. Projekte highlighted on /projekte and /projekte/*. nav-accent gradient underline shows on active links. 3) Sub-service pages (14 total) render dynamically from subservices.js data - invalid slugs redirect to home via Navigate component. 4) Mobile accordion menu works with nested expandable items for each pillar. 5) Hover states use CSS classes nav-link-base (rgba white 0.04 bg), nav-link-active (rgba white 0.06 bg with border), mega-sub-link hover (rgba white 0.05 bg). 6) SEO titles update correctly on each sub-service page.
